scope: Transfers spelling and numeral interpretation only. Units and evidence references stay unchanged.
plain: Plain text pasted; the selected interpretation is unchanged.
invalid: This copied value has an unsupported or invalid spelling or interpretation. Choose an explicit interpretation before copying.
changed: The value changed while reading the clipboard. Your edit was kept; paste again to replace it.
length: The complete copied value exceeds this editor's supported length. Nothing was pasted.
lines: This value contains line breaks that this field cannot retain. Nothing was pasted.
unavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable. Use the browser's copy and paste controls.
contextMismatch: This copied value uses a different numeral interpretation from the saved field. Nothing was pasted; change the field schema explicitly to use another interpretation.
